title: Briefing — Friday, November 27
summary: Why Pursuing Absolute U.S. AI Dominance Over China Increases Catastrophic Risk; Synthetic protein system restores chromosome stability in aging eggs, showing potential for IVF; Montana’s expanded ‘right to try’ law threatens clinical trial integrity and patient finances; Vyriad lands Big Pharma partnerships for in vivo CAR-T cell delivery platforms; Pakistani architect Kamil Khan Mumtaz abandoned modernism to revive centuries-old traditional craftsmanship.
